name: Sierra Leone Peninsula
locator: Printed p. 142, section 15, table 2, Sierra Leone Peninsula subtotal.
definition: The 67,782 subtotal is nested inside the Colony population of 76,655. It includes the 34,463 Freetown district count, plus eight other table entries. It excludes Sherbro, Isles de Los, Tassoh and Kikonkeh.

name: Sierra Leone Colony and Protectorate, as returned
locator: Printed p. 71, census dates and coverage; printed p. 142, section 15, tables 1–3.
method: sum of separate Colony census and Protectorate estimate
definition: 76,655 for the Colony plus 949,827 for the Protectorate. The Protectorate had no census. The Colony includes 1,422 people in Isles de Los outside the WWO polygon. The comparison is the 1900 research-only reconstruction for Sierra Leone in world_accounts. The difference combines reference-date, scope and method differences.

name: Sierra Leone Colony and Protectorate, excluding Isles de Los
locator: Printed p. 142, section 15, tables 2–3, including the Isles de Los row.
method: sum of Colony census and Protectorate estimate less enumerated Isles de Los
definition: 76,655 less Isles de Los 1,422 gives 75,233 for the rest of the Colony. Adding Protectorate 949,827 gives 1,025,060. The subtraction leaves the Liberia boundary mismatch unresolved. The comparison is the 1900 research-only reconstruction for Sierra Leone. The two combined returns are alternative scopes and share their component observations.
